subject.title: improve(diagnostics): surface run startup phases as session-correlated events

question: Should the closed embedded-runner phase vocabulary become a supported additive event in the public plugin diagnostic payload union?
rationale: Publishing a new discriminated-union member creates a permanent compatibility and evolution obligation for external plugins that automation cannot choose.

options.title: Approve the public event
options.body: Accept `run.execution_phase` as a public additive contract, document forward-compatible switching, and require live plugin-consumer proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the signal internal
options.body: Retain stability and support instrumentation but remove the plugin SDK event exposure and public surface changes.

options.title: Pause the proposal
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open until a broader diagnostics event-versioning policy is chosen.

recommendation.title: Approve the public event
recommendation.body: Accept `run.execution_phase` as a public additive contract, document forward-compatible switching, and require live plugin-consumer proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most strongly connects this contributor to the diagnostic bus, OpenTelemetry integration, and plugin SDK observability boundary.
